findings.desc: CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge verificationEvidence claim the story diff excludes unrelated root/docs/code changes, but the recorded command is `git diff --name-status main...HEAD -- scoped docs`, which path-filters to docs and therefore cannot prove absence of non-doc or root-level changes. A full unfiltered diff or explicit negative path check is needed as checklist verificationEvidence for the docs-only scope claim.
findings.resolvedReason: Refreshed CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge verificationEvidence to use an unfiltered git diff --name-status main...HEAD plus an allowlist negative path check. The check produced no output and exited 0, proving only B-3a80 Lattice metadata and the three scoped docs are present; path-filtered evidence is no longer relied on.

findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial and CHK-003:adversarial still record verificationEvidence as result=pass even though the exact commands fail when rerun. `rg claim boundary docs/requirements/decisions/f009-gap-analyze-high-gaps-execution-plan.md` exits 2 because `boundary` is parsed as a missing path; `rg -n implement.customerKeyRef.receiptVerified.productionDone.unlock.Layer.4 docs/requirements/decisions/unlock-layer4-production-safety-suite.md` exits 1 with no match because the regex does not match the actual note text. The docs claim boundaries look conservative and F-001 scoped-diff evidence is materially refreshed, but these pass-marked evidence commands are inconsistent with their recorded result and need refreshed executable evidence or corrected command text before REVIEW can pass.
findings.resolvedReason: Refreshed CHK-001:adversarial and CHK-003:adversarial verificationEvidence to use executable rg commands. Reran both exact commands successfully: the F-009 claim boundary command exits 0, and the customerKeyRef current-support/receiptVerified/productionDone/Layer4 command exits 0 with matching lines.

findings.desc: Final test-coverage re-review remains BLOCKED because several verificationEvidence command fields are still not executable/replayable. CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge record `git diff --name-status main...HEAD && git diff --name-status main...HEAD | awk allowlist check for B-3a80 metadata plus three scoped docs`; replaying that exact command exits 2 with `awk: cannot open file check`, so the unfiltered diff allowlist proof is described in prose rather than recorded as an executable command. A separate concrete allowlist awk command exits 0, which shows the underlying claim is likely true, but that is not the command stored on the checklist. CHK-002:adversarial and CHK-004:adversarial record `Claude CLI final review and Codex CLI final review` / `Claude CLI final review; Codex CLI final review`; those are manual transcript labels, not deterministic verification commands, and replaying the semicolon form invokes the local Codex CLI with unexpected arguments. The corrected CHK-001 and CHK-003 rg commands do execute successfully, but all intents do not yet have executable verificationEvidence commands.
findings.resolvedReason: Refreshed CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge verificationEvidence to store an executable node allowlist command, and replaced CHK-002:adversarial / CHK-004:adversarial manual host labels with executable rg commands. Reran the stored command shapes successfully: allowlist exits 0, optimization/Authority-proof rg exits 0, and forbidden-final-wording rg exits 0.
